The resort main building was nice but we were very disappointed in what we received for how much we were paying. The staff was somewhat helpful especially Logan he went above and beyond to help us.

findings.title: Terri S. (5/5)
findings.snippet: Love this place   I go in for a dr appointment twice a year   Usually stay at the Fairmont but this will be my new place

findings.title: Michael R. (2/5)
findings.snippet:
Have you ever been to Panama City Florida for spring break and had to stay at the motel 6? Good news folks, you can get the same thing in Scottsdale. 
Pretty hotel that was filled with overflowing trash bins and no available pool seats or towels. People passed out around around the pool and even a little vomit in the stair well for good measure. You read that right. $500 a night and vomit on the stairs. At one time this was a great hotel for a weekend getaway but it's sadly become a true disappointment. Wouldn't recommend this place to anyone. Even people I don't like.......

findings.title: Stephanie B. (3/5)
findings.snippet:
I would not recommend nor return to the resort. 
The good- comfortable beds, pretty landscaping, good food. Close to old town.  Best for young couples and families. 
The bad-customer service- 2 hour wait for our room, not responsive to turn down music in fitness room, locked out of our room on check out day even though we confirmed a late checkout.  Pool too crowded on the weekend. No chairs available. Very noisy. Not good for relaxation and older couples. Understaffed.

findings.title: Michele M. (1/5)
findings.snippet:
We had a 3 night stay and wanted to leave after the first night. So disappointed.

Pool- filthy, garbage everywhere, garbage cans over flowed and were never emptied through out the day. 

Pool rules no saving lounge chairs. If not being used, towels and other items will be removed after a half hour by security. Good rules which rude guest never followed. No security and chair were being saved starting at 6am. No towels Just to go swimming if you wanted. We even asked the front desk for towels and their reponce was that's house keeping. Ok, request it from house keeping as they weren't even responding. 

Bar area- filthy and bartenders were over done. They needed help. 30 people wanting to order drinks and only 2 bartenders. Where's the management to lend a helping hand? 

The only thing this place has going for it is the decor in the lobby. That's it. This is a motel six with fancy window coverings. Actual Motel Six is cleaner than this place. 

Staff needs new management. 

We're heading back to the Biltmore!

findings.title: Erin M. (5/5)
findings.snippet: The property itself is beautiful. Rooms are cozy with good bath amenities and comfy beds. Food was all delicious. We did have a hiccup with our rooms but Brandon was able to resolve the issue and come up with a solution to rectify it. 5 stars for Brandon the Operations Manager for his customer service. Only downside was that the pool is incredibly crowded and very hard to get somewhere to sit. It didn't seem like it was reserved just for hotel guests which would be my only recommendation so that hotel guests are able to relax more.

findings.title: Erika C. (3/5)
findings.snippet: Stayed here for my sisters bachelorette weekend. Love the location of this hotel, close to old town Scottsdale and entertainment district. The decor and vibe of this hotel is so cute and looks just like the pictures. Beds were comfortable and rooms were clean. Staff at hotel gave us the key to the wrong room so we walked into someone else's room which was very awkward, it was fixed and they said they would refund one night of resort fee, that didn't happen. They also charged $200 a night for incidentals which does get refunded but is an expensive inconvenience. Canal club had yummy brunch and pool had great drinks. Overall a fine experience in a very aesthetically pleasing spot!

findings.title: keith w. (5/5)
findings.snippet: The Scott is a gem.  We love across the street and whenever family or friends visit us in Arizona, we always send them here...and happy to meet up at the Canal bar for drinks.  Great staff, nicely redone. Thumbs up.

findings.title: K H. (3/5)
findings.snippet:
Favorite parts of this resort: the staff, the coffee bar/bar, and the location. It's a clean, spread out resort, that was very nice. We were less than impressed by the pools  though - it seemed like there were people spilling over from other hotels, and it was full of drunken twenty somethings doing selfies. The pools are also pretty small, and my kids didn't feel comfortable swimming there as it was full of adults drinking and not caring If they drop F bombs around little kids. 

They really need to card access the gates to the pools, there's nothing keeping people from wandering in. This is more than a suspicion, as we saw the obnoxious drunken gaggle of young ladies that were next to us the day before, walking toward the other hotels next door at the end of the day and morning after. So this is very fixable - and needed. Another flaw is the poolside food. Think gas station sandwiches at restaurant prices, and that sums it up. 

The people that work there - to a person, were friendly, helpful, and always smiling. They obviously care about the visitors, and this was very appreciated.

findings.title: Sloan L. (1/5)
findings.snippet: Not what we expected. Not relaxing. Too many bachelorette parties. Too many call girls. Too many children. Too many drunk parents ignoring their children who ran around the pool climbing on rocks, jumping off everything and throwing toys at ducks. Place is a free for all. No one bothered to clean the pool area all day.... but at 6:30 am the following morning, that seemed like a good time. Who needs sleep. Oh and the restaurant the canal club unexpectedly closed on Sunday night. Who needs food. The interior of the main building is beautiful and smells lovely, but difficult to enjoy with such crowd.

findings.title: Katie G. (2/5)
findings.snippet: Really disappointed in this hotel. We booked this hotel for our baby moon because it looked so cute, had great reviews, and seemed perfect. We "upgraded" to a courtyard view since we read other reviews and didn't want to face a parking lot.. well, we ended up getting that money back because we still faced the front parking lot, at the very end of the hotel, and had a couple trees "blocking" the view. We also didn't get the open balcony, we were completely enclosed by a cement wall. They told us they couldn't do anything to assist, so we are very disappointed in the hotel and the customer service.

findings.title: Katie S. (1/5)
findings.snippet:
Online, this place is STUNNING! Modern, chic and an influencer's dream come true. Unfortunately, like most things you see online, lots of filters and editing can make anything beautiful. 

The hotel is pretty; especially on the approach. The common areas have been developed with great care and detail. The guest rooms, on the other hand, are mass produced cattle call rooms.

 In 96-degree Arizona heat, our room never got below 70. We had to open our door each night to get a cool breeze. We asked a few people about the ac settings in our room and we were told that everything "looked ok."

When we checked-in, we were told that they had "accidentally overbooked" so we were not able to stay in the pool view room we had reserved. Yes, we were compensated,  but the point was more on presentation. Particularly still in the throws of COVID, "overbooked" is not the word you want to hear. 

Our room also wasn't ready when we arrived at 1PM. Again, the capacity and turnover seemed to be an issue.  We were given wristbands to gain entry to the pool, but decided to shop instead. The wristbands were paper and were seemingly being handed out to anyone with a pulse. 

As we got further into our stay, we were disappointed daily. The pool is an actual nightmare. While it opens unreasonably early, you would be hard pressed to find a seat even if you were there hours before. People show-up and throw towels on seats the minute it opens. Which, yes, is fine, usually. Except there are so few chairs, by the time everyone does this, good luck. By the 4th day of not being able to find a chair at the pool (at 10am), I went to the desk. There is signage posted all over the pool deck that states you cannot reserve chairs and unoccupied chairs wil be opened back to guests every 30-minutes.  The person i spoke to at the desk said "yeah, that sucks." Sure does. She said she would call security to clear out the chairs and offered me a credit and a drink ticket. The way this hotel throws credits around, it's a wonder they make any profit. I went back to the pool to wait for the big security shake-up, but it never happened. I was also told that I could wait 30-minutes and if someone doesn't claim their chair, I was well within my rights to take their chair. So, basically, stand around the pool waiting for someone to no show like a Karen on vacation. Hard pass. The chair situation was so dire, many guests took to lying on the ground outside their rooms on towels. Or, they would take the chair from their rooms out on the lawn. I didn't take my shoes off at airportbsecurity to sit on a lawn like some nosey neighbor. 

if you enjoy the Internet, this hotel might not be for you. The WiFi is so bad it s comical.  I assume it is all the influencers jamming the frequency. Do you love influencers? You better. They are everywhere. 

The food is subpar, but the drinks were good. The staff at the pool bar and grill were fantastic.  But better eat and drink quickly; last call is 4pm. Like your grandparents. Oh, and if you are underage, this is definitely the bar for you. We saw at least 4 girls underage who were served BUCKETS of White Claws. Confirmed. 

Proximity to everything in Scottsdale is definitely in The Scott's favor. We were able to walk almost anywhere. Parking wasn't a problem, either. 

This was a real sadness for us. We definitely bought into the pics on the Internet and Instagram. We have been going to Scottsdale for almost 7-years. For our vacation, we definitely want better service and access to amenities. If you don't need wifi, good food, cool air or pool chairs, enjoy your stay!  

If you want to feel like you are on vacation while you are on vacation, look elsewhere.

findings.title: Patricia D. (4/5)
findings.snippet: Stayed here for 3 nights at end of March 2021. Would definitely stay here again. Room was nice and had some well thought-out features along with quality fixtures in the bathroom. Only complaint was the food/restaurant service. I've never been to a resort where they won't seat you at 10:10 in the morning because the kitchen is closing at 10:30-11:30 am. Huh? Restaurant was always 3/4 empty yet host was constantly telling everyone, "we don't have any tables available at this time". I saw this happen repeatedly over the span of several days so very inconvenient.  Luckily many restaurant options very close by.

findings.title: Emilu H. (1/5)
findings.snippet: My friends and I went to The Scott during the day on a Saturday to enjoy some drinks poolside. We arrived completely sober and went to the bar to order drinks. The bartender refused to serve us and when we asked why she told us to talk to the general manager. We called him over and he decided to humiliate us at the bar, declining us service and insisting we were "too drunk" even after we  explained  to him we were sober and he must be mistaking us for someone else. I have never experienced such Humiliating, degrading, and horrific service. I will never go back to this establishment and encourage others to never go back as well. It was truly the WORST experience I have ever had. I felt targeted, embarrassed, and angry-and simply for no reason.

findings.title: Ashley D. (1/5)
findings.snippet: The customer service is terrible. No one seemed happy or friendly. Extremely over priced for what you get. At best it is comparable to a best western. The guy working at the bar was rude and treated us poorly. The fact no one offered to help us with our luggage was unacceptablE. The facility only had stairs which made it extremely difficult to haul all our luggage to our second story room. The older lady working in the spa was rude and not friendly. I did not feel welcomed or comfortabl.

findings.title: Darrell M. (3/5)
findings.snippet: Stayed at The Scott four nights during spring break.  The grounds are really nice, which is a plus.  The service at the Canal Club was very, very slow.  Same can be said for the onsite restaurant.  This is not the fault of the employees.  It always looked like they could have used additional staff members to deal with the crowds, so I blame management.  It was a consistent problem throughout my stay.  The actual hotel rooms were ok, but probably a bit over priced.

findings.title: Mark J. (1/5)
findings.snippet:
I can literally tell you that the Scott has provided the absolute worst service I have received my entire traveling life. 
My wife and I travel very often and stay in some really nice places. We where told the Scott is the place to stay while in AZ., but wow where we poorly guided. It started with the moment we checked in - we payed for an early check in and our room wasn't ready at 3:00 when we arrive - fail! 
The restaurant and bar staff was probably the rudest and most informed group I have ever seen. We ordered food several times while there, and our shortest wait was an hour. Dated rooms, creepy pictures in the rooms, no elevator (can't wait for the ADA to read this) and overall poorly managed shitshow of a pool - oh did I mention that they sell pool day passes on the weekend so there's no way your getting a chair. 
I asked to talk to the manager today before I checked out and the girl at the desk told me he wasn't there - she may have been embellishing a bit.  Don't waste your money for this overpriced, poorly managed, rude property!

findings.title: Kristin J. (1/5)
findings.snippet: So disappointed! We booked this hotel thinking it would be nice and relaxing. It was the opposite. Not to mention the customer service was terrible. And if you asked for something it was like you offended them. The front desk staff was miserable and we paid for early check in.... nope room wasn't ready. We brought our dog's and when I booked they said we would have bottom floor to get in and out with them... they lied. We couldn't get a chair at the pool any of the days unless we went down at 6am and that wasn't even a guarantee. They apparently sell day passes at the pool so that would explain why. We paid a lot of money for this place and I would say your better off finding something else shoot the holiday inn express probably would have been better. And when they call it a resort and spa Don't believe it. No spa. We got $255 massages which were amazing but we had no sauna, no anything. Again after a week here and the service I so sad and it was for my birthday to celebrate and enjoy. Anyways don't waste your money and time going here not worth it.

findings.title: Carolene M. (4/5)
findings.snippet:
We had heard a lot about this resort and decided to go for dinner and drinks. The drinks were great. Food was decent. 
We sat in the area outside between the pool and the bar. The pool was crazy busy - literally packed. I was shocked at how many were in it during COVID. The bar was constantly busy with people from the pool and those of us sitting nearby. We had to order food from the bar because it was before they began serving. The bartenders were super busy but very helpful and friendly. 
We wore masks though when we were away from our seats.

findings.title: Monique V. (1/5)
findings.snippet: Such a horrible staff and experience, I would recommend people to not stay here.  Don't waist your time or money.

findings.title: Arige R. (1/5)
findings.snippet:
This hotel put us through HELL last night.  My toddler has just showered and I was putting him to sleep as my husband was out on the balcony smoking. The security  looked up at him from the street and said " u have 30 minutes to get out of the room" no warning, no notice upon arrival of a strict no smoke zone OUTSIDE. Let me tell you it was CLEAR that if you are not white you are not welcomed. the scott's really represents the racism of Arizona. The security was clear with his racism and unjustified actions. We had no choice but to drive home in the middle of the night can barely keep our eyes open for 6 hours!  Never heard of this absolutely ridiculous 
Aside from the holes in the bed sheets and a room that was not properly cleaned up before our arrival and no
Qtips or body wash in the bathroom.  And disgusting pool filled with leaves and sticks. Nothing about it screamed worth $500 a night !

findings.title: Christina P. (5/5)
findings.snippet:
The Scott Resort is one of my favorite resorts in Scottsdale. I mean- what a vibe. Right? If you know you know. And if you've seen the pictures of this picturesque Havana 1930s-modern resort then you get the vibe check. 

I stayed here for the first time during Summer 2020 as part of my birthday R&R; and to get some work done in a place other than home. 
The gentleman at the front desk was very nice, professional and made sure I was all set for my stay when I arrived. 

I felt very comfortable staying here during the pandemic. From the lobby, to the restaurants, the grounds, pool and my room- everything was clean. All the staff I encountered during my stay were wearing masks and making sure they were distanced taking precautions.

I enjoyed both of the pools during my time here. One is a beach pool with sand leading into the water (as a beach girl from Long Island I miss having my toes in the sand!) and the other pool has a tiki bar where you can order food and drinks. Their Helen & Maude drink will NOT disappoint! Also their hummus platter is amazing with plantain chips. The rooms have a mini refrigerator in them so I was able to store any leftover food and have a late night snack in bed. (Isn't that the best?)

I sat at the bar as well as in the restaurant during my stay and the food and drinks were great. 
I honestly can't say anything bad about this resort. It's a perfect place to relax and have a staycation or vacation if you're visiting AZ! Especially if you're looking to adventure around Scottsdale, you can't beat this location.

findings.title: Aditya H. (4/5)
findings.snippet:
The Hotel:
The Scott Hotel is absolutely beautiful. The lobby, dining areas, entry ways, etc are all absolutely gorgeous. Great for photos and an overall feeling of relaxation. The rooms are okay, low ceilings not that much lighting and the shower floors are old and cracked (-.25). The rooms still have a great vintage vibe and are accessorized well. The toiletries smell AMAZING. Nice, natural, artisan scents, think if Diptyque came out with a lower priced line for the everyday consumer.  The bed was very comfortable. Everything was really clean. They put A LOT of thought into how the hotel looks, feels and smells. They created vignettes for photos and cool places to hang out and relax. This is not a resort, as the name and the resort feel would lead you to believe. It is VERY swanky motel/hotel.

Check-in:
Check-in was very different than I expected especially based on the daily rate for the hotel (-.25). There was no assistance with bags, or any 'let me show you to your room'. I understand this might be different because of the pandemic. There should be carts or something available. You have to walk through the entire lobby and through a labyrinth around the pools, and bar, there is a section that is on an incline! So that was not fun. 

The Service: 
The service was great. Some people are chatty, some aren't, but everyone was nice and courteous.  Courtney at the front desk and Austin in the restaurant and bar are my faves! One negative (-.5). The celebrant's parents planned a really nice dinner with champagne and reserved it weeks in advance, set a menu, excel docs, the works. When we arrived at dinner no one on staff knew what we were talking about. The restaurant manager dropped the ball, but Austin picked it right up and made the night one to remember. 

Getting Around/ Things to do: I'm pretty chill, so I am content to sit around the pool and in the restaurant reading a book for 3 days, but most people are not. So for you lot, there are multiple restaurants within walking distance. There are some really nice ones a short uber ride away. The uber to camelback took us about 20 minutes. The hotel also offered yoga classes. All we did was eat, drink, hike, and shop so that's all I got haha.  

Black Travelers: I traveled with a large group of Black girls (10) and we were treated with kindness and respect during our stay. The city of Scottsdale is a different story, but this isn't about Scottsdale :) 

The trip was planned during Val day weekend which ended with the ice-storms in Texas ( most of the group was from Houston). The staff heard about our plight and helped us out with a less expensive rate. We didn't take it because we wanted to be closer to the airport in case we need to fly standby. When we found out we were going to be stuck for the week, we called back to try and get that rate and were quickly denied. I was peeved because it wasn't my decision to leave, but it is what it is. It was nice of them to offer in the first place.

findings.title: Brittany F. (5/5)
findings.snippet: My hubs and I did a quick staycation here, absolutely worth it. Very cute place but very convenient. They allow you to text instead of having to call them to do anything. Make reservations at the restaurant, check out, order something. It's very handy. We loved our stay and will likely be back

findings.title: Dawn E. (5/5)
findings.snippet:
What a beautiful place to stay. So warm and welcoming! The room was superb! The drinks were super yummy! The staff was fantastic! 

WILL BE BACK!!!!

findings.title: Regina C. (5/5)
findings.snippet: This hotel is so cute and fun! The rooms are funky and spacious. The front desk staff  are so helpful and accommodating. Trendy little spot for a great price!

findings.title: Brenda B. (5/5)
findings.snippet:
We decided to escape Cali COVID Thanksgiving and booked The Scott's Resort & Spa. We got a great rate so we were not sure what to expect. Our room was clean, spacious and had a sort of Caribbean Chic vibe. The bed is VERY comfy, smart tv connected easily to my Netflix, and the Nespresso machine in room was perfect. The mini frig was barely cool, but we made do with ice. We were a little disappointed that the gym was so restricted because of COVID, but we were able to workout at a couple local gyms for under $10 using class pass & mindbody apps!  The grounds and pool are very pretty and everyone was able to enjoy their time without being too close. The location is fantastic and their concierge was accessible via text anytime ( we messaged at midnight and immediate service). Note: if you stay on second floor there is no elevator so you will have to carry bags up a flight of stairs. Overall was a perfect place for this last minute trip and we will definitely visit again... 
added bonuses (in my opinion) :
Large room ( king size bed ) 
Shower was strong & hot
Powerful full-size hair dryer
Plenty of mirrors, including full length mirror
USB & outlets with nightstand on both sides of bed
Table and corner bench to eat at
Large desk space
Large balcony with chairs
Parking available outside your building for easy access 
Beachside pool spots, fire pits, poolside bar
Great place for pics ( instagram etc) 
Check was noon, much better than most 11am checkouts 
Staff was attentive and check in / out was fast & easy
My BF left all his dress clothes and 1/2 way home realized it, they had ALL of it!

findings.title: Nathan W. (5/5)
findings.snippet:
The resort is beautiful and so relaxing. The lobby just buts you at ease with the décor and plants everywhere. The staff was very friendly and accommodating. We spent the day at the pool and enjoyed the beautiful Arizona sun. 

We enjoyed lunch and cocktails poolside and the food and drinks were wonderful. They had some great poolside food options and loved they had servers so you didn't have to go to the bar.

The rooms were well appointed and clean. I will keep this resort as an option when I come back to the Phoenix area. The resort is also minutes from Old Town Scottsdale and Scottsdale Fashion Square.

findings.title: Omari D. (5/5)
findings.snippet:
This has to be one of my favorite locations whenever I need a quick getaway... or as we say around here "Staycation" from the normal grind. The pandemic has created a limited atmosphere of interaction so it can be hard but think of this place's lobby, hotel room, and "comfortable seating nooks" around the property as a means to help calm your mind and spirits (that's what it does for me)

The 1st thing that really stands out is the vibe and atmosphere that is presented. From the music that's playing throughout the property to the fireplace that's lit, (even when it a bit warm outside haha) to the Canal Bar serving up some good food and drinks on demand. The intent is to lose yourself and that what happens for me as it's absolutely relaxing and during my stays, I no longer feel like I'm in Arizona but some semi-tropical resort. 

The staff is very helpful and they've remodeled the place which makes it feel more comfy. The rooms we've had were very similar on separate occasions, but I have to admit the feel of the recent visit seemed to be a bit more "refreshed" vs the previous room.  Feel free to use us as a meetup place with friends and family or enjoy a relaxing weekend in the pool as it is relaxing and cool... especially with the "beach sand" area.

findings.title: Serena C. (5/5)
findings.snippet: This is such a Great Staycation place Mary at the front desk was so nice to accommodate us checking in early. The next day having Brooke for poolside service made it all the better!10/10 recommend

findings.title: Lynne G. (2/5)
findings.snippet:
I'm giving the Scott 2 stars for the friendliness of the front desk staff and all the hidden seating areas on the property. 

My husband and I were looking forward to a special weekend to celebrate our 20th wedding anniversary and we were both SO incredibly disappointed in The Scott.  I paid to upgrade pour room to a "pool" view, which was on the 2nd floor and blocked by overgrown landscape and umbrellas.  As we entered the hall to find our room at 3:30 pm the hall was covered with room service dishes outside many doors and the hall had the strangest odor (like mildew or something similar).  When we got in our room we were both shocked by the cheap quality of furnishings and the lighting was SO dark and drier (even after turning on every light).  The cleanliness of our room was so bad, dirty pool towels on our balcony, spots on the mirror and doors in restroom etc.  I wanted to surprise my husband so upon booking I paid for the champagne and strawberries and at checkin I asked that it be delivered at 7pm... I was so frustrated when it arrived 4:30ish while we were getting ready for dinner.  The strawberries were SO small such a waste of the money paid for this special service.  After dinner we had planned to spend the rest of the evening in The Canal club, but the empty tables were all dirty and it was impossible to find someone to clean it off so we decided to just go back to room.  The next morning we headed down to breakfast to the smallest brunch menu ever.  You also could tell they didn't have enough staff working and our poor server was running around like crazy.  We decided after breakfast to call it an early stay and headed back to check out and get our bags.  Remember earlier I mentioned the room service dishes outside of rooms in our halls, well yup those SAME dishes were outside the same doors.

I'll end this by saying DO NOT waste your money by staying here.  We've stayed at cheaper hotels who's rooms were nicer, cleaner and all around a MUCH better experience then The Scott.  It's crazy to know this property went through a 15million dollar renovation just two years ago.  So disappointed.

findings.title: Ryan Matthew W. (4/5)
findings.snippet:
4.5 out of 5! I drove all the way to Scottsdale from LA for work back in September and I was so excited to enjoy my time there in a gorgeous resort! I stayed for 4 nights.

PROS
-amazingly comfortable beds! I can't tell you enough how real one and soft they are. I even tried to take the sheets off so I could see what bed it was lol
-gorgeous pool area with nice decor and Lots of seating
-delicious drinks/cocktails, I loved all of them
-the design of the rooms and hotel over all, I'm an interior designer and was there for a project so that definitely stood out to me
-Convenient parking

CONS
-embarrassing moment at the front desk, not entirely their fault but was still uncomfortable. My work booked my stay on hotel tonight. I have a corporate card that has my company's name on it, not my name personally. They refused to take the card for resort fees and incidentals so I had to put it all on my personal debit card. Front desk employees had to keep going to back office to ask questions about their policies etc, just made me feel sort of cheap, holding up the line because they wouldn't accept my company card. The refund for the incidentals took way too long.
-the AC barely worked at all. Our room was way too hot and way too humid.


Would I recommend? Probably yes, and I'd return myself as well. But if any of the cons happened again it would be my last visit. However, I loved the pool so much that a pic I took of the umbrellas has been my wallpaper for almost three months, HAHA!

findings.title: Angie P. (5/5)
findings.snippet: The Scott Resort and Spa is a dream! We stayed for 4 days and it was magical. The lobby has a lovely scent, the grounds are gorgeous! We enjoyed the food, the pool, the black out curtains in our room and the area. Thank you Scott Resort for making our first trip to AZ amazing!

findings.title: Sarah R. (2/5)
findings.snippet:
Came here for a night away and to celebrate our anniversary. Front desk wasn't helpful at explaining where our room was or even giving a room number..they said they'd just text it to us. 

Next upon arriving to our room that over looked the pool were two people pretty much having sex.  Great..just exactly what I wanted to see as I'm walking into our room. 

I will be contacting the front desk but I doubt they'll do anything. Needless to say we will never come back here...

findings.title: Mariam M. (3/5)
findings.snippet:
I wouldn't consider this  a resort at all-more of a motel that had a refresh. 

The rooms are okay-nothing resort like about them. Bathrooms are pretty small, but updated. Beds are pretty comfy,  the carpet is dark and old. There's a weird stench throughout the hallways. 

Housecleaning didn't do a good job because we found a condom wrapper near the bed skirt while we were getting ready to leave. Disgusting. 

When we were assigned our first room, we were told we would have a nice view which was a parking lot. Our room had a loud noise which was coming from the AC and there was still dust on the nightstands. This room had an awful odor that smelled like someone poured too much carpet cleaner on the floor. 
We called front desk to ask for a better room with a better view. They stated there were limited rooms due to a wedding party. Our next room was okay until the last day, where we found the used wrapper while cleaning-it was located right under the bed skirt. 
This rooms view was another parking lot. 


Front desk didn't provide us with information about yoga classes onsite, where the fitness center was located, spa or other amenities. 

The food was really good at the canal club-bartenders were extremely attentive and made great drinks. 

Resort is close to the stores and restaurants in old Scottsdale. 

Definitely wouldn't stay here again.

findings.title: Darian F. (5/5)
findings.snippet: LOVE THIS PLACE! Good drinks, great price and Brooke at the bar by the pool is so fun and great! I wish all bartenders are as awesome as her!

findings.title: Rewa L. (2/5)
findings.snippet:
Let's start with the positives. Inside of the grounds around the pool and lagoon sitting area we're very clean, rooms were clean and comfortable, and great proximity to the Scottsdale Fashion Mall, and variety of restaurants. That however is the extent of the good. 
Now for the not so wonderful, bed was way too soft, we got a crap room on the junk side of the hotel, meaning next to a busy road and the loading and unloading area. 
We were given a king size bed even after mentioning that we were two friends in town for doctors appointments and a  day of R&R. And the bed was made short sheeted. So after if climbing in we quickly got out and remade the bed. 
Not much R&R was to be had as we were woken early by the loud traffic and the early morning leaf blowing it had to be done before 8 o'clock in the morning. 
Around the exterior of the grounds there were dirty gloves, beer bottle caps, and paper, sitting and deteriorating in the weather. 
Won't be returning.

findings.title: Meagan R. (3/5)
findings.snippet: The resort is cute and quaint! Loved the vibe ! Staff was super nice but the service was not good at all! Every time we ate somewhere or ordered something it either took so long or the forgot to put our order in. For how cute this place is and how expensive it is to stay here, I was a little disappointed that the service was not good.

findings.title: Debbie W. (5/5)
findings.snippet: Check in was easy. Staff was friendly. Everyone was wearing masks and everything looked clean. The room was great. It had a coffee maker and refrigerator as well as a little bar with glasses. We were on the ground level with a patio, easy access to the beautiful pool. There are fire pits and sandy beach style pool area and a hot tub. Landscape was well kept and everything was very clean. Housekeeping was friendly and always said hello when walking by in the hallway.  Great hotel Great location! I would definitely stay there again.

findings.title: Libby E. (5/5)
findings.snippet:
Check in was super easy and quick. We walked into  into the Lobby felt open and fresh, so inviting.  Our room was amazing so cute and romantic. We had the perfect weekend at the sand pool. 
Perfect get away for sure.... and my massage was the  icing on the cake. 
We will be back!!!!

findings.title: Allison E. (5/5)
findings.snippet:
I feel like I'm living in an instagram post. This place is stunning.  I don't even know where to start. The living greenery is incredible, and it's everywhere. You feel like you're somewhere tropical complete with a beautiful cocktail in hand. The pool area is so inviting (they even have a real sand pool). The rooms are so comfy, but chic at the same time. I didn't want to mess up the covers because everything was so pretty. 

The service is on another level. The valet was welcoming (even though I self parked). Check in staff was patient and friendly, and answered all of my bazillion questions. The restaurant and bar staff were accommodating and recommended some super tasty drinks and nibbles. 

I could go on, but I will stop here and just say GO HERE. It is a hidden gem in Scottsdale and makes you feel special and elite.

findings.title: Crystal B. (5/5)
findings.snippet: I went here for a weekend get away with a girlfriend. We had an amazing time, beautiful resort and an amazing spa. We'll be back to hangout out in the sand at their beach pool!!!!

findings.title: Diane H. (3/5)
findings.snippet:
Surprise getaway with my childhood bestie! This place did not disappoint. Upon entering the lobby of the resort, we found it to be spacious, beautifully decorated and clean. The staff were friendly and answered our questions. After driving around back to our room, we  found a little black gate to enter the resort from the parking lot. It made me feel a little uncomfortable knowing how easy it would have been to just jump the fence. The hallways led to our room which were open and gave it a motel kind of vibe to me. Though it wasn't the case at all, it just felt that way with the hallway doors open right to an exit to the parking lot. 

We found our room to be spacious and modern. The Courtyard guest room was just right for the two of us. The two queen size beds were super comfy and the bathroom design was gorgeous. We had a tiny patio to sit at outside in the shade which overlooked absolutely nothing. Still, it was nice in the shade, with lovely plants and trees and quite secluded/private. 

I ate breakfast in the resort restaurant. The Canal Club was quiet and fairly vacant when I arrived. I ordered the fruit and granola bar. The drizzle of honey over the granola and fruit paired nicely with the Greek yogurt. It was delicious and filing. It was also one of the cheapest things on the menu. I suppose that's what it costs at a resort though. If I replicated this meal of yogurt with granola and fresh fruit at my house, it would probably cost $2/person. 

Anyways, it was fun to feel a bit spoiled eating a simple meal all by myself. My bestie and I then relaxed in the pool which we had entirely to ourselves. It was clean and large. Lots of water features to create a calming atmosphere. Plenty of seating throughout and enclosed areas to feel a bit secluded. We didn't feel like guests lounging poolside were staring at us. So that was nice. 

Overall it was a nice getaway for a reasonable price. Though we didn't delve into the spa amenities, it did look tempting. My bestie and her hubby ended up returning for a weekend getaway themselves a few months later since it fit their budget and was accommodating.

findings.title: Emily C. (4/5)
findings.snippet:
The Scott is in a wonderful location, and is a good resort getaway. Our vacation was cancelled due to COVID so we made a last minute reservation here to make up for it. Definitely not the same as being at an all inclusive in Mexico but very nice. I will say the drinks and food were extremely expensive seeing as you already paid so much for the room and resort fee. We did get a good discount because of COVID.

The pool was extremely crowded for a COVID weekend- which we were not expecting. Make sure you get there early, people "save" seats with towels and will be gone for hours. The staff was very attentive and nice. All in all we would definitely go back, but don't know if we would pay full season price.

findings.title: Taylor R. (1/5)
findings.snippet: ~40 percent of guests aren't wearing masks... And the front desk/reception doesn't seem to care!

findings.title: Madison H. (5/5)
findings.snippet: My friend and I stayed here from out of town for a friends weekend and we had a wonderful time. The room was very nice and eclectic along with the rest of the atmosphere of the hotel. The staff was very friendly and helpful too. I'll definitely be going back!

findings.title: Amy Z. (2/5)
findings.snippet: I took my daughter and her friends for a 2 night staycation this past weekend.  Although I hadn't been on the property previously, my daughter and her friends had been previously.  The resort was very cute and the girls had lots of fun taking pictures, however the service at the resort left a lot to be desired.  I had researched the resort previously and had spoken with the staff prior to booking to find out about their COVID procedures especially at the pool.  I felt comfortable enough to book, however it was evident shortly after checking in, that mask wearing was NOT enforced and while at the pool 50% of the chairs had been removed, the manager told me herself that the capacity of the pool was full.  It was extremely crowded.  We rented a cabana and the service poolside was extremely lacking.  We ordered food and drinks and it took just under 2 hours for our food to arrive.  At one point our server stopped by and said it would be about 10 minutes.  After 30 more minutes had passed I questioned the server who admitted that she had not put our order in and would go and do that right away.  We received our food about 45 minutes later.  They did comp our food which helped, but it was still a disappointment.  The atmosphere at the pool was very loud and an extreme party atmosphere.  We even witnessed a guest pass out on the pool deck due to too much drinking and partying.  She was carried out of the pool area because she was unable to walk.  The pools were not kept as well as I had imagined they would be.  The water was a bit cloudy and the pools seemed to have a lot of debris in them.  My daughter and her friends commented the their stay before had been classy and this visit was a bit trashy.  I will say that I was happy with our room and the cleanliness of the room as well as how friendly the housekeeping staff was.  In addition, our beds in the hotel room may have been the most comfortable hotel beds we have ever slept in.  Unfortunately the poor service combined with seemingly not following COVID procedures and social distancing guidelines will keep me from returning to the Scott or recommending this resort to my friends and family.

findings.title: Lisa D. (5/5)
findings.snippet: This hotel is awesome! As soon as you walk in to the lobby, you feel like you are on some island somewhere and definitely get that Cuban vibe. The rooms are also nicely decorated and the beds are very comfortable. The pool has individual gazebos and an area with sand. At the restaurant I tried a coconut mojito which I was able to enjoy by the pool or the outdoor patio area. I also had their ceviche which was very tasty.

findings.title: Morgan C. (5/5)
findings.snippet: We came here for our anniversary and they did the best job at making it feel so special! We had an amazing time. I have a thing for boutique hotels, and this one is completely adorable. The food at the canal club is delicious. Everything about our stay was wonderful. The rooms and the property itself are so pretty!

findings.title: William B. (5/5)
findings.snippet: My wife and I went for a little get away at The Scott. It was a celebration of our anniversary and my birthday. My wife could not have picked a nicer place. We had a couples massage that was very expensive but even with the crazy price it was wonderful and well worth it. All the staff went above and beyond for us. There was this one woman who stood out in a exceptional staff.  She was amazing. She worked the bar area at the pool and her name is Brooke. We were just enjoying our time in the pool and she was beyond attentive constantly trying to make us feel special and taken care of. It is hard to stand out in a group of wonderful staff filled with friendly people but she did. She found out we were celebrating our anniversary and she brought over these delish cinnamon ball thing's complimentary just to be sweet. The hotel is beautiful but having Brooke remember our names was just special. She went so far above and beyond I truly can't wait to go back. The Scott was so relaxing and has the best staff around!

findings.title: Brooke W. (5/5)
findings.snippet:
My husband and I went for several days at The Scott. It was a celebration of our anniversary and his birthday. We could not have picked a better place. We had a couples massage and it was slightly more that I expected. Even with the price it was wonderful. All the staff went above and beyond for us. There was
There was this one person who stood out in their staff and she was amazing. She worked the bar area at the pool and her name is Brooke (I didn't get her last name).  We were just enjoying our time in the pool and she was beyond attentive. In a staff filled with friendly people she stood out. she found out we were celebrating our anniversary and she brought over these delish cinnamon ball thing's complimentary just to be sweet. I have been all over this world and I stayed at a super luxurious place in Luxembourg and they couldn't even touch the staff at this place. The hotel is beautiful but having Brooke remember our names was just the topping on the cake. she went so far above and beyond I truly can't wait to go back. Our AC needed tweaking and the guy who did that was such a joy. The Scott has the best staff around!

findings.title: David R. (5/5)
findings.snippet: What a beautiful place! My girl stayed at their sister location in Carmel and we had to see it. We went and have stayed twice now! Jack is the best. He works the front desk and met us with a smile and kindness both times! He even helped with a confrontation we had with some bummer guests! Because of Jack, we'll go back! (That rhymed!) thank you for the hospitality!

findings.title: Chrissy S. (4/5)
findings.snippet:
We came here on a whim and used my credit card points... I probably normally wouldn't have splurged bc I am pretty frugal. 

This place was so cute! It's an instagram influencers dream! Everything was so beautifully decorated. I wish I had more time to take photos and take everything in - but that's hard with two little kids.

It wasn't super kid friendly but they were accommodating. There were at least 6 bachelorette parties going on.

We hung out at the beach pool which seemed more kid friendly. And I loved the decor of the beds - which were also comfy! 

I would definitely come back sans kids next time, and If I had more credit card points!

findings.title: Anna C. (5/5)
findings.snippet: I have been absolutely blown away by the service Tyler Staten provided. He went above and beyond to accommodate requests for a special stay. He provided thorough communication and an excellent attention to detail.

findings.title: Miles G. (1/5)
findings.snippet:
MOLD!!! WATER COMING FROM INSIDE OF WALLS!!! AND UNDER TILE


Let me start by saying I thought the place was cute at first. Me, my girlfriend and her toddler stayed for 2 nights. The first night our AC didn't work so we were transferred into another unit but not until the next day when we had already suffered because there was no one answering the phones at the front desk. They switch our rooms and do not comp us the night. The room they transfer us into has a puddled carpet but I don't complain because I'm not that type of person me and my girlfriend simply put towels down. After a few hours of showers and sink use we notice water coming from inside of the walls, under the tiles, and under the front door. Maintenance comes in and is able to pull the dry wall off like it's a piece of paper. We then began inhaling mold etc. and to top it off Stephen Jackson or Johnson the GM of the resorts will not return any of my calls whenever I have his employees try to get in contact with him. I run an Instagram page with over 2.1 million followers and will be continuing on there. I also DM'd their Instagram from my personal page with the videos

findings.title: Phillip H. (5/5)
findings.snippet: I just had brunch at the Scott and my experience was AMAZING! Amy in the restaurant was truly remarkable and made our experience! I highly recommend trying this place and ask for Amy! She is the best!!!

findings.title: Lauren H. (3/5)
findings.snippet:
Ok strap in....this may be a lot. So my two girlfriends and I were looking for a spot to have our girls weekend and we found a great deal online so we went with it!!! 

Upon first arrival the lobby feels like you're walking into a dream vacay in the Bahamas it is truly beautiful!! And the Canal club is super cute. 

Flights got in super early, so they let us do early check in which was super sweet of them. However they asked if we would like a first or second floor room we said second floor he gave us our keys and we were on our way. We went to our room, on the first floor......and there was a huge gap where the back French doors should have closed, letting us all the 100 degree air!! So we promptly returned to the front desk and he so kindly upgraded us to a pool view room on the second floor. Which seemed great!! But, they AC was broken!!! so the poor engineering man was a regular to room 460! Finally after two nights they got us a fan. 

The pool however was a dream, and the pool staff were freaking angels they were so amazing and the pool food was so so good! 

All in all I'd say we got what we paid for. It was such a stinking cute venue but we had our fair share of difficulties.

findings.title: Alyssa W. (5/5)
findings.snippet: This place is absolutely amazing !! Customer service was outstanding all of our servers new exactly what we needed before we could even ask and everyone was so friendly, you can tell everyone here loves what they do and takes pride in their job. Everywhere you turn there is a new amazing picture opportunity for your instagram this place really is picture perfect. On top of it all the rooms were very spacious, extremely clean, and super comfy beds. We will 100% be staying here again with out a doubt they made us feel like we were at home. Huge shoutout to Olivia for the coffee each morning and our amazing server Will at night for dinner!!

findings.title: Britney A. (5/5)
findings.snippet: Love the boho decor and vibe of this place! Rooms are cute and comfortable, canal club is a trendy spot for happy hour and best of all they are dog friendly!

findings.title: Sara S. (5/5)
findings.snippet: This resort is straight out of a magazine. Picture-perfect decor, food and outdoor gathering areas. My friends and I bought a day pass for pool access and it was 100% worth it. We were able to lounge by the pool and eat and drink from the cafe all day. We left feeling sun kissed and relaxed. Next time we are in Scottsdale, we will definitely we staying at The Scott.

findings.title: Jennifer S. (5/5)
findings.snippet: I was a little nervous to book this hotel based on some reviews on Yelp so if you are in the same boat-do not pay attention to them. They must be crazy picky when it comes to hotels because our stay here was great! First off the lobby/patio/pools were amazing, the decor is beautiful and the smell of the lobby (!!!!!) is so good. If anyone knows how they get it to smell that amazing please fill me in. The rooms are renovated and have a boho feel to them plus the bed is crazy comfy! All the staff there are so friendly and accommodating. Don't think about it just book it, you won't regret it!

findings.title: Marc S. (5/5)
findings.snippet: Excellent hotel in a prime location!  Thank you so much for the investment in the community!

findings.title: Laura D. (2/5)
findings.snippet:
I wanted to like this hotel because it has a beautiful design / aesthetic, gorgeous landscaping with multiple pools.

However, the management gaps well outweighed the positive aspects. During our 3 night stay we experienced 2 complete failures.

After our first night the front desk called to ask us to change rooms because they had scheduled a contractor for our room and didn't have it marked when we had checked in. They "upgraded" us (to the 2nd floor w courtyard view) but my husband is photophobic so we always keep the drapes shut and didn't get anything out of it, a statement credit would have been better for us.

On the third night, after coming back from the wedding we attended in our full uncomfortable garb we were met with a dysfunctional room door lock. My husband went to the front desk to get another key. That one didn't work either. Husband goes back a second time and they seem to know what's going on; the door lock battery has failed. This apparently happens often enough that they had a device (fishhook) to open the door manually that was broken from so much use. Another worker ran around to find a second one that was in better shape and mercifully after 40 mins of sitting in the hallway feet aching the door was opened. They couldn't even fix the door until a later time so we couldn't both leave the room at the same time, thank goodness we were checking out the next morning.

While we were awkwardly waiting to be let into our room our help mentioned that the hotel has had 3 owners in the past 15 yrs and that was contributing to some chronic maintenance issues. He also said they were planning to upgrade the door locks soon since the battery system is obsolete & unreliable. While I appreciate the self awareness, it would be better for them to be on a more active / preventative maintenance schedule given the technology issues. We let him know we also had been room reassigned and he apologized and said they would "do something" for us on checkout.

To seal the deal when we checked out the "do something" turned out to be a 9% discount on our bill. To me that was not fair compensation for how terrible our stay was. I would definitely discourage anyone considering a stay here. There are plenty of more reliable options in the area.

findings.title: Morgan C. (2/5)
findings.snippet: So I never write reviews but I'm giving two stars for the Spa at this resort. One star for each therapist, who were great! Otherwise the treatments were WAY over priced and they put a mandatory 20% gratuity on every service, which I was blind sided by. I checked the website and nothing was in plain sight that I could see. I'm all about tipping, but this was a bit much, especially since the treatments were so expensive. Won't be going there again.

findings.title: Jamie C. (5/5)
findings.snippet: My boyfriend and I stayed here for our one year anniversary and it was absolutely perfect! The rooms were remodeled recently and have such an aesthetically pleasing vibe (and the bed is comfy!) We got drinks at the Canal Club which is the bar in their lobby - every cocktail we tried was delicious and the bartender was very attentive. We had dinner in their restaurant and all of the food was amazing! I would highly recommend getting the ceviche! They have places to hang out all throughout the lobby and we found an area outside to play corn hole. I will definitely be staying here again if I have the chance!

findings.title: Michelle O. (2/5)
findings.snippet: The spa at The Scott Resort and Spa (La Vidorra Spa) is a huge disappointment.  There are no locker rooms, no sauna or steam rooms, AND showers are not available for all guests.  After our eighty minute massages, we were told that we could not use the showers bc those are reserved for customers who get specific treatments.  They also did not offer slippers, so we were forced to sit in our sneakers, wearing our robes, covered in massage oil.  The only place to relax after the massage was in a high traffic spot where we sat in our robes watching staff walk around with towels from room-to-room.  This is the first place I've been that calls itself a "resort and spa" where locker rooms, sauna, and steam room were not included.  But the fact that a shower was also not the baseline standard was completely unexpected and a huge disappointment.  The staff were cordial and kind, but the overall experience was below standard.
